description: Period-level window diagnostics from monthly period LS summary. Each monthly period = one window. NOT true per-bar investment-window data.
disclaimer: Research diagnostics only. Not portfolio metrics. Not trading signals.
nonoverlap_note: Non-overlapping uses monthly subsampling at horizon step. True non-overlapping requires per-bar data; monthly aggregates are approximate.
period_level_note: Current implementation uses monthly period LS returns from factor_level_period_long_short_summary.csv. True per-bar / non-overlapping investment-window diagnostics require raw per-bar LS return output and are deferred.
